_: A REAL, RUNNABLE config, not an illustration. This is vid67 (shreyansh,
__: `launch-your-agent`, 35.233s, delivered), and every number in it is a
___: measurement of that one film. guard.example.json shows every key that
____: exists; this file shows one film's actual answers. Re-derive, never inherit.
_project: the in-repo copy of the film, which is CODE ONLY: reference-builds carry no media by policy, so a run against it reports ASSET for assets/aroll.mp4, assets/bandtrack.mp4 and the fonts, and IMG0 for nothing because the film has no . That is the gate working. For the clean PASS, point it at the film directory that has its assets: `--project ~/Desktop/shreyansh\ claude/hf67`.
_stage: the root is 2160x3840 and #stage is 1080x1920 under transform:scale(2). These are the UNSCALED numbers, which is the space guard.py measures in. Writing the root's numbers here puts every band at half its real height and the gate passes everything.
_beats: 41: the 20 cut() boundaries, one word onset inside each hold, and 35.1, four frames short of the 35.233 duration. tools/qa/shoot-sheet.py reads the same list, so the beat map is written once.
_caption_replay: vid67 has 70 caption cues written by a tl.call(). tl.time(t, false) suppresses events, so without this replay #cap carries no text at any beat, isText is false, and the crown, band, rail, text-on-text and contrast rules all measure nothing while printing PASS. The composition publishes `window.__CAPS = CAPS;` for exactly this.
_face: two states, hard cut, never a tween: FULL is inset(0px 0px 0px 0px), SPLIT is inset(620px 0px 0px 0px). The threshold is 610, between the two observed values and on neither, so a one-pixel rounding cannot flip the state. off_state names a state this film does not have, because his face never leaves the frame.

split._: B-roll band y0-620 full width, his face below it, picture pushed down 380. Worst crown 660 over 176 Vision samples of this take (crown y280-375 raw), 40px below the seam: no caption may run past it. No ink_zone: the graphics band IS a full-width video track. Measured, a zone inside it reads 241.3% covered, because ink is summed per element and overlapping elements double count, so the floor can never fail here.

full._: his face full-bleed, untouched. No graphics rectangle exists, so ink_zone and the crown are DELETED rather than widened: a zone here measured 212.9% covered, which is a check that cannot fail. The band track must be dark here, and that is the one thing this state can assert.

_face_windows: one window covering the film, deliberately. He is on screen for every frame of vid67: under the band on SPLIT beats, whole-frame on FULL beats. Recorded as a decision so nobody later reads it as an omission. On a film where he leaves, this is the list of windows he MAY appear in and everywhere else is forbidden.
_void: inert on this film: no state carries an ink_zone. Kept so the next edit that adds a graphics panel has the floor already sitting here.
_stylesheets: all of vid67's CSS is inline in index.html. [] is correct, not lazy: guard.py only PICHASHes a sheet with an href, and an inline sheet cannot go stale against the document it lives in.
_allow: empty, and it stayed empty: the clean run has nothing to exempt. An entry that matches nothing fails the run as ALLOWDEAD.
